answer: Entry is priced like saffron: each new agent identity posts a slow-vest escrow sized to the value it wants to move, and one established agent cipher-signs the pledge, forfeiting a cut of its own stake if the identity is ever proven sybil. A farm cannot slip velvet-gloved clones through a burst of registrations, because every extra identity needs full collateral plus a backer willing to risk forfeiture, while honest agents simply vest out. The backing graph is public, so repeat offenders find no future backers.
